fields.title: current item version title
fields.time: canonical current anchors and required source proof; no follower traversal

related_items.predicate: read(each related item) AND disclose connecting relation AND every returned prerequisite; own unsafe time yields unavailable time, not omission of the readable core

relations.predicate: disclose relation AND read both endpoints

temporal_bindings.predicate: disclose binding AND relationship AND read source AND target; current revision

primary_location.predicate: disclose item-location edge AND referenced location; canonical primary selection

notification_profiles.predicate: read applied profile and pinned revision AND disclose application

policies.predicate: disclose current item-version policy AND intent AND every separately governed target/recipient/catalog reference needed for that evidence

work.predicate: disclose notification work AND its policy/intent/target evidence; item-linked work only

attempts.predicate: disclose attempt AND work AND referenced policy/intent/target evidence

delivery_targets.predicate: disclose current approved target snapshot including target_ref; item-referenced targets only

subject_roles.predicate: disclose current role row AND referenced subject; assignment does not grant access

authoring_receipt.predicate: disclose creation receipt AND every resource/identity whose facts are committed by its receipt identity; never release a digest as redaction

sections.policies: singleton count/status_counts over fully authorized current-version policies
sections.work: singleton count/status_counts over fully authorized item-linked notification work
sections.attempts: singleton count/status_counts over fully authorized item-linked attempts

agenda.counts: Sum status buckets equals count. Not opportunity expansion or delivery-success proof. Empty authorized subset yields zeros, not null. Overflow of a bounded authorized computation yields context_unavailable.
agenda.recurring_summary_scope: item-root evidence, repeated per occurrence; never claim occurrence-specific counts

receipt_selection.predicate: successful persisted receipt whose canonical created-item result identifies this item and creation version; exclude updates, no-op replays and receipts merely mentioning it
receipt_selection.selection: authorize candidates first, then earliest created_at_utc and lexicographic command_receipt_id; duplicate matching summaries collapse by receipt ID
